text:
alejandra_csm: Heads-up: ArcadiaPay reported intermittent spikes during promo windows, p95 jumping to ~900ms. Renewal in 4 weeks. Proposing a short pilot: int8 quant for stateless routes + compact-model swap during peak routing, plus per-template KV caching. Need ops/eng + ML signoff before customer sync.

ranjit_ml: We ran a quick bench on similar workload; INT8 with layernorm preserved gave ~35% latency drop and <2% quality delta on spot checks. Suggest calibration using 150 anonymized prompts. Keep multi-turn flows on fp32.

noah_eng: I can spin the canary. Proposal: phased traffic 4% -> 20% over 36h, rollback on any of: p95 > 450ms, error_rate increase >0.3%, or quality_score drop >4%. Will add dashboards and alerting.

violet_ops: Add autoscale buffer (min_replicas=3) for canary window and enable trace sampling at 15% to capture tails. Also prepare region-pref: primary us-east-1, fallback eu-west-1.

alejandra_csm: For customer-facing deck include: p95, cost_per_1k_tokens, before/after snippets, and recommended fallback policy. I'll book a 20-min review with ArcadiaPay on Wed.

ranjit_ml: Quant profile to test (string): `{"quant":"int8","calib_samples":150,"per_channel":true,"preserve_ln_fp32":true}`. We'll run the A/B eval on their top-120 prompts and a 30-sample multi-turn validation.

noah_eng: Routing policy suggestion (as text): `{"policy":"latency_first","fallbacks":["redwood-compact-s"],"cost_cap":2.00,"regions":["us-east-1","eu-west-1"]}`. I'll attach this to the canary job.

deploy_bot: Canary launched: arcadiapay-int8-3955551234 id=canary-2147. Initial traffic=4%. Monitors: p95_latency, error_rate, cost_delta, quality_spotcheck.

selene_csm: I'll collect ArcadiaPay's top templates and SLO targets before Tue EOD and share in the channel.

alejandra_csm: Good plan. Tagging @ranjit_ml @noah_eng @violet_ops  please confirm readiness by Tue noon so we can show progress in the sync.

violet_ops: Confirmed  autoscale and traces set.

noah_eng: Canary infra task created `#canary-arcadia-2147`. Will stream metrics to shared dashboard and ping when live.

alejandra_csm: Thanks team  we'll capture customer feedback during the review and iterate the quant/profile as needed. :thumbsup:
